artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime and let $\mathbb{F}_p$ denote the field with $p$ elements. For $\lambda \in \mathbb{F}_p$ and a subset $A \subseteq \mathbb{F}_p$, write $\lambda A = \{\lambda a : a \in A\}$ and $A + 1 = \{a + 1 : a \in A\}$.

Does there exist an absolute constant $\varepsilon > 0$ with the following property: for every sufficiently large prime $p$ there exists $\lambda \in \mathbb{F}_p$ such that every subset $A \subseteq \mathbb{F}_p$ with $|A| < p/2$ satisfies
$$|A \cup (A+1) \cup \lambda A| > (1+\varepsilon)|A|\,?$$

(It is moreover suspected that $\lambda$ cannot be taken to be $O(1)$, i.e. bounded independently of $p$.)
